        axes[row,0].step(t,raw.real,where='post',alpha=.3,c='C0',label='Programmed I')
        axes[row,0].step(t,raw.imag,where='post',alpha=.3,c='C1',label='Programmed Q')
        axes[row,0].plot(tf,z.real,c='C0',label='Played I');axes[row,0].plot(tf,z.imag,c='C1',label='Played Q')
        axes[row,1].step(t,abs(raw),where='post',alpha=.4,label='Programmed magnitude')
        axes[row,1].plot(tf,abs(z),c='k',label='Played magnitude')
        if row==1:axes[row,1].axhline(ss*MAX_G/(np.pi/(2*.6)),c='r',ls='--',label='200 ns limit')
        for ax in axes[row]:
            ax.set(title=channel,xlabel='Device-envelope time (ns)',ylabel='DAC scale',xlim=(-5,duration+8))
            ax.grid(alpha=.25);ax.legend(fontsize=6)
    fig.suptitle(title);finish(name)
cdarrays=(qraw,sraw,qf,sf,words)
waveform_figure(cdarrays,'CD beta=1: 300 ns, hard 200 ns swap limit',300,'CD_IQ_and_magnitude')
'''),M(r'''## 3. Fixed-sequence strength sensitivity

This curve holds timing, qubit phases and the relative pump pattern fixed,
and scales only its overall coupling downward. The target remains beta=1.
It is a calibration sensitivity curve, not a separately reoptimized envelope.
Only allowed strengths are shown. All 18 input columns are propagated and
compared at two output cutoffs for every point.'''),C(r'''
points=[];count=0
for factor in [1.,.99,.98,.97,.96,.94,.92,.88,.8]:
    previous=None
    for levels in [64,96]:
        space=cd.Space(levels,9);initial=np.eye(2*levels,dtype=complex)[:,space.inputs]
        T=cd.target_columns(space,'cd',1.)
        V=hw.propagate(qf,sf*factor,initial,cd.DT/8,order=8,fast=True)
        if previous is not None:
            pad=np.zeros_like(V);pad[:len(previous)]=previous
            difference=float(max(np.linalg.norm(V-pad,axis=0)));assert difference<1e-9
            count+=V.size
        previous=V
    peak=max(abs(sf))*factor
    assert peak<=MAX_G
    points.append(dict(minimum_swap_ns=1000*np.pi/(2*peak),fidelity=float(abs(np.vdot(T,V)/18)**2),
                       cutoff_change=difference))
assert len(points)==9 and count==31104
pd.DataFrame(points).to_csv(OUT/'strength_sensitivity.csv',index=False)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7.4,3.4),constrained_layout=True)
ax.plot([p['minimum_swap_ns'] for p in points],[100*p['fidelity'] for p in points],'o-')
ax.axhline(99,c='k',ls='--');ax.axvline(200,c='r',ls=':')
ax.set(xlabel='Peak equivalent vacuum swap time (ns; larger is weaker)',ylabel='Gate fidelity (%)')
ax.grid(alpha=.3);finish('CD_allowed_strength_sensitivity')
print('STRENGTH CHECK:9points;162columns;',count,'cutoffcomparisonamplitudes')
'''),M(r'''## 4. Conditional squeezing remains within the limit

The fixed target is

$$S_z(r)=\exp[\tfrac r2\sigma_z(a^2-a^{\dagger2})],\qquad r=8\ln(10)/20.$$

The 120-pulse, 3.61 us construction gives 99.0724% coherent gate fidelity.
It never approaches the sideband limit: the largest filtered coupling is
equivalent to about a 282 ns swap. Every qubit pi pulse is 30 ns and every
pump transition is the same 10 ns Cartesian interpolation used above.

The [complete squeezing pulse table](runs/higher_order_cd/verified/compressed_squeeze_n120_sequence.csv)
lists all qubit and pump phases. Apply the **one common final qubit Rz** in
the results table after the complete train; it is included in the fidelity.
This accepted sequence came from systematic pulse-pair removal and phase
correction of the earlier 128-pulse gate. The attempted 112- and 96-pulse
constructions failed 99%; their saved results are not recommendations.'''),C(r'''
sqrecord,sqarrays,sqmodel=source_and_arrays('squeeze_8db')
sqcert=certificate('squeeze_8db')
waveform_figure(sqarrays,'Conditional squeezing: 8 dB in 3.61 us',3610,'squeezing_IQ_and_magnitude')
print('Squeeze minimum equivalent swap time (ns):',sqcert['actual_min_swap_ns'])
print('Final qubit Rz after the whole train (rad):',sqcert['qubit_frame_Rz'])
'''),M(r'''## 5. Individual input diagnostics

These state fidelities show where the error is concentrated among the 18
basis inputs. They do not replace the coherent process metric: relative
phases between different inputs also count in the reported gate fidelity.
Leakage is retained throughout; no state is renormalized into the input space.'''),C(r'''
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(10,3.5),constrained_layout=True)
for ax,name,title in zip(axes,[selected,'squeeze_8db'],['CD beta=1','8 dB conditional squeeze']):
    data=np.load(OUT/'verified'/f'{name}_columns.npz')
    overlaps=np.sum(data['target'].conj()*data['output'],axis=0)
    F=float(abs(overlaps.mean())**2)
    assert abs(F-certificate(name)['fidelity'])<1e-13
    for offset,label in [(0,'Input g'),(9,'Input e')]:
        ax.plot(np.arange(9),100*abs(overlaps[offset:offset+9])**2,'o-',label=label)
    ax.set(title=f'{title}; process F={100*F:.4f}%',xlabel='Input photon number',ylabel='Basis-input state fidelity (%)')
    ax.grid(alpha=.3);ax.legend(fontsize=8)
finish('individual_input_checks')
'''),M(r'''## 6. Fresh independent simulation

The final cell independently evolves all 18 CD columns at 128 oscillator
levels and both squeezing boundary inputs g8/e8 at 384 levels. It compares
complex amplitudes against the saved certificates. The earlier full
squeezing certificate separately checked every column and target cutoff.

The 12 locally fitted CD candidates and two references have 252 verified
input columns and 56,448 independent amplitude comparisons. The 200 ns
limit is an explicit peak-norm assertion on every waveform. No coupler or
board experiment is invoked, and no global optimality claim is made.'''),C(r'''
space=cd.Space(128,9);initial=np.eye(256,dtype=complex)[:,space.inputs]
replay=hw.propagate(qf,sf,initial,cd.DT/8,order=16)
target=cd.target_columns(space,'cd',1.)
saved=np.load(OUT/'verified'/f'{selected}_columns.npz')['output']
pad=np.zeros_like(replay);pad[:len(saved)]=saved
error=float(np.max(abs(replay-pad)));F=float(abs(np.vdot(target,replay)/18)**2)
assert replay.shape==(256,18) and error<1e-10 and F>.99
assert max(abs(sf))<=MAX_G
print('FRESH CD:18columns;',replay.size,'amplitudes;maxdifference',error,'F',F)
qr,sr,qSq,sSq,wSq=sqarrays
spaceSq=cd.Space(384,9);inputsSq=np.eye(768,dtype=complex)[:,[16,17]]
replaySq=hw.propagate(qSq,sSq,inputsSq,cd.DT/8,order=16)
replaySq*=np.exp(-1j*sqcert['qubit_frame_Rz']*spaceSq.z/2)[:,None]
targetSq=cd.target_columns(spaceSq,'squeeze',cd.R_8DB)[:,[8,17]]
savedSq=np.load(OUT/'verified/squeeze_8db_columns.npz')['output'][:,[8,17]]
padSq=np.zeros_like(replaySq);padSq[:len(savedSq)]=savedSq
errorSq=float(np.max(abs(replaySq-padSq)))
assert replaySq.shape==(768,2) and errorSq<1e-10 and max(abs(sSq))<=MAX_G
print('FRESH SQUEEZE:2boundaryinputs;',replaySq.size,'amplitudes;maxdifference',errorSq)
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(10,3.3),constrained_layout=True)
for j,ax in enumerate(axes):
    a=(abs(replaySq[:,j])**2).reshape(-1,2).sum(axis=1)
    b=(abs(targetSq[:,j])**2).reshape(-1,2).sum(axis=1)
    ax.semilogy(b,'--',label='Exact target');ax.semilogy(a,label='Simulated gate')
    ax.set(title=['Input g8','Input e8'][j],xlabel='Output photon number',ylabel='Probability',xlim=(0,200),ylim=(1e-9,1))
    ax.grid(alpha=.3);ax.legend(fontsize=8)
finish('fresh_squeezing_boundary_inputs')
''')]
notebook=nb.v4.new_notebook(cells=cells,metadata=dict(kernelspec=dict(display_name='Python 3',language='python',name='python3')))
nb.validate(notebook);nb.write(notebook,ROOT/'higher_order_cd_and_squeezing.ipynb')

calibrate_coupler.py.source:
"""Calibrate an assumed circuit to the measured 600ns swap with Floquet maps.

This avoids confusing a lowest-order g(phi) formula with a measured strong-drive
coupling. One-period propagation is far cheaper than fitting many 600ns traces.
Circuit energies/participations remain explicit assumptions.
"""
from dataclasses import replace
import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import eig,polar
from coupler_phase_model import *


def floquet_pair(circuit,scale=.045,na=3,nc=8,dt=.005):
    fp=(circuit.f_cavity_GHz-circuit.f_qubit_GHz if circuit.pump_drive_GHz is None else circuit.pump_drive_GHz)
    N=2*na*nc
    result,U=microscopic(None,circuit,na,nc,dt,initial_state=np.eye(N,dtype=complex),
                         rf_samples=(np.full(16,scale,complex),np.zeros(16,complex)),duration_ns=1/fp)
    _,_,E,_=operators(circuit,na,nc)
    U*=np.exp(-1j*E/fp)[:,None] # restore lab-frame one-period unitary
    values,vectors=eig(U)
    assert np.max(abs(abs(values)-1))<1e-9
    indices=[1,2*nc]
    weights=np.sum(abs(vectors[indices])**2,axis=0)
    pair=np.argsort(weights)[-2:]
    ground=int(np.argmax(abs(vectors[0])**2))
    energies=-np.angle(values)/(2*np.pi/fp)
    # H0 was globally shifted. Remove the ground quasienergy before lifting.
    relative=energies[pair]-energies[ground]
    relative+=np.round((circuit.f_qubit_GHz-relative)/fp)*fp
    rotation,_=polar(vectors[np.ix_(indices,pair)])
    effective=(rotation*relative)@rotation.conj().T
    return dict(qubit_on_GHz=float(effective[0,0].real),
                cavity_on_GHz=float(effective[1,1].real+fp),
                coupling_GHz=float(abs(effective[0,1])),
                coupling_phase_rad=float(np.angle(effective[0,1])),
                detuning_GHz=float((effective[1,1]-effective[0,0]).real),
                minimum_pair_weight=float(min(weights[pair])),
                columns=N,amplitudes=U.size,coupler_levels=nc,timestep_ns=dt)


def calibrate():
    circuit=Circuit();default=circuit.parameters();flux=default['flux_per_DAC']
    pump=circuit.f_cavity_GHz-circuit.f_qubit_GHz
    history=[]
    print('START PERIOD-MAP CALIBRATION: exact cosine, measured600ns reference',flush=True)
    # Fixed-point corrections are small. Each update enforces the measured
    # driven mode references and the measured on-resonance swap, not a target CD.
    for iteration in range(5):
        configured=replace(circuit,pump_drive_GHz=pump,qubit_drive_GHz=Circuit().f_qubit_GHz,
                           flux_per_DAC_override=flux)
        measured=floquet_pair(configured)
        desired=1/(4*600.)
        history.append(dict(iteration=iteration,circuit=configured.__dict__,floquet=measured))
        print('FLOQUET CALIBRATION',iteration,measured,'flux_per_DAC',flux,flush=True)
        flux*=desired/measured['coupling_GHz']
        circuit=replace(circuit,
            f_qubit_GHz=circuit.f_qubit_GHz+Circuit().f_qubit_GHz-measured['qubit_on_GHz'],
            f_cavity_GHz=circuit.f_cavity_GHz+Circuit().f_cavity_GHz-measured['cavity_on_GHz'])
    configured=replace(circuit,pump_drive_GHz=pump,qubit_drive_GHz=Circuit().f_qubit_GHz,
                       flux_per_DAC_override=flux)
    final=floquet_pair(configured,nc=10,dt=.0025)
    print('FINAL EXACT PERIOD CALIBRATION',final,flush=True)
    record=dict(circuit=configured.__dict__,final=final,history=history,
                assumption='measured6.8GHz and4GHz tuning; illustrativeEC and participations; calibrate600ns swap and driven carriers')
    path=ROOT/'runs/coupler/floquet_calibration.json';path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
    return record


if __name__=='__main__':calibrate()

calibrate_programmed_family.py.source:
"""Calibrate primitives and physical observables, then test a fixed CD target.

Constant-drive Floquet maps determine DAC amplitude and driven resonances
without using CD outputs. Vacuum first moments subsequently fix displacement
strength/direction, and fixed reference observables fix two common frames.
Those calibrations never optimize the gate trace or fit a new CD target.
Frequency corrections are explicit IQ chirps at the original NCOs.
"""
import json
from dataclasses import replace
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import brentq
from coupler_phase_model import *
from calibrate_coupler import floquet_pair


def calibrate_family(kind):
    reference=json.loads((ROOT/'runs/coupler/floquet_calibration.json').read_text())
    base=Circuit(**reference['circuit'])
    source=ROOT/'runs/audit'/('transition_fit_constant.json' if kind=='constant' else 'smooth_cartesian.json')
    parameters=np.array(json.loads(source.read_text())['parameters'])
    desired=1/(4*300.)*parameters[8] # GHz, independently requested JC strength
    samples=[]
    def cost(scale):
        result=floquet_pair(base,scale=scale)
        samples.append(dict(DAC_scale=scale,**result))
        return result['coupling_GHz']-desired
    scale=brentq(cost,.035,.09,xtol=1e-8)
    drive=base
    for iteration in range(3):
        result=floquet_pair(drive,scale=scale)
        pump=result['cavity_on_GHz']-result['qubit_on_GHz']
        drive=replace(base,pump_drive_GHz=pump,qubit_drive_GHz=result['qubit_on_GHz'])
    checked=floquet_pair(drive,scale=scale,nc=10,dt=.0025)
    parameters[8]=scale/.09
    record=dict(kind=kind,parameters=parameters.tolist(),target_coupling_GHz=desired,
                reference_circuit=base.__dict__,driven_circuit=drive.__dict__,Floquet_check=checked,
                qubit_IQ_detune_GHz=drive.qubit_drive_GHz-base.qubit_drive_GHz,
                pump_IQ_detune_GHz=drive.pump_drive_GHz-base.pump_drive_GHz,
                pump_phase_correction_rad=-checked['coupling_phase_rad'],
                peak_DAC_scale=scale,samples=samples)
    path=ROOT/'runs/coupler'/f'family_calibration_{kind}.json';path.write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
    print('FAMILY PRIMITIVE CALIBRATION',kind,'scale',scale,'target_g_GHz',desired,'measured',checked,
          'IQdetunesGHz',record['qubit_IQ_detune_GHz'],record['pump_IQ_detune_GHz'],flush=True)
    return record


def programmed_words(record,repeats=1,gain=1.):
    """Exact SDK payload, with all detuning and phase corrections explicit."""
    shape='phase' if record['kind']=='constant' else 'cartesian'
    words=smooth_motif(record['parameters'],repeats,gain,shape)
    t=np.arange(len(words['qubit']))*cd.DT*1000
    delay=22.65625 # known baseband RFDC group delay, ns
    program=json.loads(hw.PROGRAM.read_text())
    result={}
    for key,channel,pulse,detune in [('qubit','DAC7','idle_pi',record['qubit_IQ_detune_GHz']),
                                   ('sideband','DAC10','pump',record['pump_IQ_detune_GHz'])]:
        values=sample_to_complex(words[key])*np.exp(2j*np.pi*detune*(t+delay))
        if key=='sideband':values*=np.exp(1j*record['pump_phase_correction_rad'])
        result[key],_=hw.sdk_load(values,channel,program[pulse]['name'])
    return result


def in_calibrated_frame(output,record,na,nc,duration_ns):
    base=Circuit(**record['reference_circuit']);driven=Circuit(**record['driven_circuit'])
    dq=driven.qubit_drive_GHz-base.f_qubit_GHz
    da=driven.qubit_drive_GHz+driven.pump_drive_GHz-base.f_cavity_GHz
    phase=(np.arange(na)[:,None,None]*da+np.arange(2)[None,None,:]*dq)*np.ones((1,nc,1))
    return output*np.exp(2j*np.pi*phase*duration_ns).reshape(-1,1)


def observer_frames(output,na,nc,alpha=.5):
    """Calibrate TWO common frames from fixed observable reference states.

    No target matrix or gate fidelity is an argument. By linearity the cached
    n<=8 columns exactly give the two normalized truncated coherent inputs
    |+x> tensor |+/-alpha>. This avoids repeating a costly full propagation.
    The omitted tail of a true coherent preparation is bounded explicitly.
    """
    from scipy.special import gammaln
    from scipy.stats import poisson
    means=[];coherences=[]
    for sign in [1,-1]:
        value=sign*alpha;n=np.arange(9)
        coefficients=np.exp(-abs(value)**2/2+n*np.log(abs(value))-.5*gammaln(n+1))*np.exp(1j*np.angle(value)*n)
        coefficients/=np.linalg.norm(coefficients)
        state=((output[:,:9]+output[:,9:])@coefficients/np.sqrt(2)).reshape(na,nc,2)
        means.append(np.sum(np.sqrt(np.arange(1,na))[:,None,None]*state[:-1].conj()*state[1:]))
        coherences.append(np.sum(state[:,:,0]*state[:,:,1].conj()))
    slope=(means[0]-means[1])/(2*alpha)
    return dict(reference_alpha=alpha,cavity_R_rad=float(np.angle(slope)),
                qubit_Rz_rad=float(np.angle(sum(coherences))),slope_magnitude=float(abs(slope)),
                input_coherent_tail_norm_bound=float(np.sqrt(poisson.sf(8,alpha**2))),
                calibration_observables='two cavity first moments and mean qubit coherence; no target or gate-trace fit')


def vacuum_strength_calibration(kind):
    """A physical first-moment calibration, separate from the all-input test.

    Only the two vacuum inputs |+x,0> and |-x,0> determine strength/direction.
    No full gate trace and no Fock n>=1 output enters this calibration.
    """
    record=json.loads((ROOT/'runs/coupler'/f'family_calibration_{kind}.json').read_text())
    base=Circuit(**record['reference_circuit']);history=[]
    for iteration in range(3):
        driven=Circuit(**record['driven_circuit']);scale=.09*record['parameters'][8]
        for _ in range(2):
            f=floquet_pair(driven,scale=scale)
            driven=replace(base,qubit_drive_GHz=f['qubit_on_GHz'],
                           pump_drive_GHz=f['cavity_on_GHz']-f['qubit_on_GHz'])
        record['driven_circuit']=driven.__dict__
        record['qubit_IQ_detune_GHz']=driven.qubit_drive_GHz-base.qubit_drive_GHz
        record['pump_IQ_detune_GHz']=driven.pump_drive_GHz-base.pump_drive_GHz
        words=programmed_words(record)
        na,nc=10,8;initial=np.zeros((2*na*nc,2),complex)
        initial[0]=1/np.sqrt(2);initial[1]=np.array([1,-1])/np.sqrt(2)
        result,out=microscopic(words,base,na,nc,.005,initial_state=initial)
        out=in_calibrated_frame(out,record,na,nc,result['duration_ns']).reshape(na,nc,2,2)
        means=np.sum(np.sqrt(np.arange(1,na))[:,None,None,None]*out[:-1].conj()*out[1:],axis=(0,1,2))
        beta=(means[0]-means[1])/2;unconditional=(means[0]+means[1])/2
        history.append(dict(iteration=iteration,peak_DAC_scale=scale,
                            conditional_beta_real=float(beta.real),conditional_beta_imag=float(beta.imag),
                            unconditional_alpha_real=float(unconditional.real),unconditional_alpha_imag=float(unconditional.imag),
                            columns=2,elapsed_seconds=result['elapsed_seconds']))
        print('VACUUM CALIBRATION',kind,history[-1],flush=True)
        if iteration<2:
            record['parameters'][8]*=.4/abs(beta)
            record['pump_phase_correction_rad']+=np.angle(beta)
    record['vacuum_calibration_history']=history
    record['calibration_mode']='two vacuum first moments; no n>=1 gate output fitted'
    (ROOT/'runs/coupler'/f'vacuum_calibrated_{kind}.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
    return record


if __name__=='__main__':
    import sys
    from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor
    if len(sys.argv)>1 and sys.argv[1]=='vacuum':
        print('START vacuum first-moment strength/direction calibration; no all-input fidelity fitted',flush=True)
        with ProcessPoolExecutor(2) as pool:list(pool.map(vacuum_strength_calibration,['constant','cartesian']))
        raise SystemExit(0)
    print('START independent constant-drive calibrations, no CD target fitting',flush=True)
    with ProcessPoolExecutor(2) as pool:list(pool.map(calibrate_family,['constant','cartesian']))

capped_cd_study.py.source:
"""CD search with the user's hard 200 ns minimum vacuum-swap time.

All qubit pi pulses keep their calibrated 30 ns Hann envelope. A small
number of pump coefficients (two per cell) controls evolution during and
between those pulses. Pump I/Q changes use 10 ns quintic transitions.
Every objective uses the SDK words and the full RFDC response. A linear-map
norm bounds the whole response, rather than bounding I and Q separately.
"""
import os
os.environ.setdefault('OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS','1')
os.environ.setdefault('OMP_NUM_THREADS','1')
import argparse,json,time
from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix
import cd_trains as cd
import hardware_check as hw
from higher_order_cd import CorrectedTrain,ROOT

OUT=ROOT/'runs/swap200';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
MIN_SWAP_NS=200.
MAX_G=np.pi/(2*MIN_SWAP_NS*.001)


class CappedCD(CorrectedTrain):
    def __init__(self,cells,gap_ns,phase_control=False,levels=48,edge_overlap=False):
        super().__init__(cells,levels,True,False,'cd')
        self.phase_control=phase_control
        half_gap=int(round(gap_ns*.001/(2*cd.DT)))
        assert abs(2*half_gap*cd.DT*1000-gap_ns)<1e-10
        cell_samples=24+2*half_gap
        self.half_gap=half_gap;self.cell_samples=cell_samples
        outer=0 if edge_overlap else 4
        count=2*outer+cells*cell_samples
        self.qshape=np.zeros(count,complex);self.qcell=np.full(count,-1,int)
        for j in range(cells):
            start=outer+j*cell_samples+half_gap
            self.qshape[start:start+24]=cd.pi_samples();self.qcell[start:start+24]=j
        self.knots=2*cells
        W=np.zeros((count,self.knots))
        half_cell=cell_samples//2
        assert 2*half_cell==cell_samples
        for j in range(self.knots):W[outer+j*half_cell:outer+(j+1)*half_cell,j]=1
        W[:4,0]=np.sin(np.pi*np.arange(4)/8)**2
        W[-4:,-1]=np.cos(np.pi*np.arange(4)/8)**2
        u=np.arange(8)/8;h=10*u**3-15*u**4+6*u**5
        for j in range(1,self.knots):
            start=outer+j*half_cell-4
            W[start:start+8]=0
            W[start:start+8,j-1]=1-h;W[start:start+8,j]=h
        self.W=csr_matrix(W)
        # For all complex knot coefficients z, |K z| <= ||z||_infinity
        # times the row sum of |K|. This enforces a radial, physical bound
        # even while the phase changes and after the interpolation filters.
        K=np.column_stack([hw.rfdc_interpolate(W[:,j]) for j in range(self.knots)])
        self.filter_gain_bound=float(np.max(np.sum(abs(K),axis=1)))
        self.radius_bound=MAX_G*.998/self.filter_gain_bound  # includes int16 rounding margin

    def expand(self,p):
        n=self.cells;m=self.knots
        radius=p[n:n+m]
        angle=p[n+m:] if self.phase_control else np.zeros(m)
        return p[:n],-1j*radius*np.exp(1j*angle)

    def arrays(self,p,quantized=True):
        result=super().arrays(p,quantized)
        assert max(np.max(abs(result[1])),np.max(abs(result[3])))<=MAX_G*(1+1e-12)
        return result

    def evaluate(self,p,gradient=True,quantized=True,outputs=False):
        result=super().evaluate(p,gradient,quantized,outputs)
        if not gradient or outputs:return result
        value,g=result;n=self.cells;m=self.knots
        radius=p[n:n+m];angle=p[n+m:] if self.phase_control else np.zeros(m)
        da=g[n:n+m];db=g[n+m:]
        dr=da*np.cos(angle)+db*np.sin(angle)
        dangle=radius*(-da*np.sin(angle)+db*np.cos(angle))
        return value,np.r_[g[:n],dr,dangle if self.phase_control else []]


def check_gradient():
    errors=[];rng=np.random.default_rng(200)
    for phases in [False,True]:
        model=CappedCD(4,5,phases,24)
        p=np.r_[rng.normal(0,.1,4),np.full(8,5.),rng.normal(0,.1,8) if phases else []]
        _,g=model.evaluate(p,quantized=False)
        for _ in range(3):
            v=rng.normal(size=len(p));v/=np.linalg.norm(v);e=1e-5
            fd=(model.evaluate(p+e*v,False,False)-model.evaluate(p-e*v,False,False))/(2*e)
            errors.append(float(abs(fd-g@v)))
    assert len(errors)==6 and max(errors)<2e-5,errors
    (OUT/'gradient_check.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(directions=6,errors=errors),indent=2)+'\n')
    print('CAPPED GRADIENT:6directions;maxerror',max(errors),flush=True)


def fit(job):
    start=time.monotonic();n=job['cells'];phases=job['phase_control']
    model=CappedCD(n,job['gap_ns'],phases,edge_overlap=job.get('edge_overlap',False))
    if n in [8,10]:
        rows=json.loads((ROOT/'runs/constant_pump_gaussian/binary_cd_summary.json').read_text())['results']
        source=max((r for r in rows if r['job']['cells']==n),key=lambda r:r['fidelity'])
        phi=np.asarray(source['qubit_phases'])
    else:phi=np.resize([0.,0.,np.pi,np.pi],n)
    if phases:phi=phi+.05*np.sin(np.linspace(-np.pi,np.pi,n))
    duration=(8+n*model.cell_samples)*cd.DT
    initial_g=min(2/(duration-.005),model.radius_bound*.98)
    initial=np.r_[phi,np.full(model.knots,initial_g),
                  .08*np.sin(np.linspace(-np.pi,np.pi,model.knots)) if phases else []]
    if 'initial' in job:
        initial=np.asarray(job['initial'])
        initial[n:n+model.knots]=np.minimum(initial[n:n+model.knots],model.radius_bound)
    history=[];best=[np.inf,initial.copy()]
    def objective(p):
        value,g=model.evaluate(p);history.append(value)
        if value<best[0]:best[:]=[value,p.copy()]
        if len(history)%40==0:
            print('CAPPED FIT',job['name'],'eval',len(history),'bestF',1-best[0],flush=True)
        return value,g
    def callback(p):
        if best[0]<.005 or len(history)>=180 or time.monotonic()-start>100:raise StopIteration
    bounds=[(None,None)]*n+[(0.,model.radius_bound)]*model.knots
    if phases:bounds += [(None,None)]*model.knots
    result=minimize(objective,initial,jac=True,method='L-BFGS-B',bounds=bounds,
                    callback=callback,options=dict(maxiter=220,maxcor=25,maxls=25,ftol=1e-13,gtol=1e-8))
    report,_,_,words=model.evaluate(best[1],False,outputs=True)
    qraw,sraw,q,s,_=model.arrays(best[1])
    peak=float(max(abs(s)))
    report.update(job=job,parameters=best[1].tolist(),history=history,evaluations=len(history),
                  initial_fidelity=1-history[0],command_us=len(qraw)*cd.DT,
                  programmed_peak_g=float(max(abs(sraw))),played_peak_g=peak,
                  played_min_swap_ns=1000*np.pi/(2*peak),
                  hard_min_swap_ns=MIN_SWAP_NS,filter_gain_bound=model.filter_gain_bound,
                  coefficient_radius_bound=model.radius_bound,seconds=time.monotonic()-start,
                  optimizer_message=str(result.message))
    (OUT/(job['name']+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
    print('CAPPED RESULT',job['name'],'F',report['fidelity'],'Tns',report['command_us']*1000,
          'minswapns',report['played_min_swap_ns'],'eval',len(history),flush=True)
    return report


def study(workers):
    jobs=[]
    for n,gap,phases in [(8,5,False),(8,10,False),(10,0,False),(10,2.5,False),(10,5,False),
                         (10,0,True),(10,2.5,True),(10,5,True),(12,0,False)]:
        jobs.append(dict(name=f'cd_n{n}_gap{gap:g}_phase{int(phases)}',cells=n,gap_ns=gap,
                         phase_control=phases,min_swap_ns=MIN_SWAP_NS))
    print('START CAPPED STUDY:',len(jobs),'fits;all18inputs;minswap200ns',flush=True)
    with ProcessPoolExecutor(workers) as pool:rows=list(pool.map(fit,jobs))
    assert len(rows)==len(jobs)==9
    (OUT/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
    print('COMPLETED CAPPED STUDY:',len(rows),'fits;',18*sum(r['evaluations'] for r in rows),'inputcolumns',flush=True)


def edge_study(workers):
    jobs=[]
    for n,gap,phases in [(10,0,False),(10,0,True),(8,5,True)]:
        job=dict(name=f'edge_n{n}_gap{gap:g}_phase{int(phases)}',cells=n,gap_ns=gap,
                 phase_control=phases,min_swap_ns=MIN_SWAP_NS,edge_overlap=True)
        if n==10:
            source=json.loads((OUT/f'cd_n10_gap0_phase{int(phases)}.json').read_text())
            job['initial']=source['parameters']
        jobs.append(job)
    print('START EDGE-RAMP STUDY:',len(jobs),'fits;all18inputs;minswap200ns',flush=True)
    with ProcessPoolExecutor(workers) as pool:rows=list(pool.map(fit,jobs))
    assert len(rows)==len(jobs)==3
    (OUT/'edge_summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
    print('COMPLETED EDGE-RAMP STUDY:',len(rows),'fits;',18*sum(r['evaluations'] for r in rows),'inputcolumns',flush=True)


if __name__=='__main__':
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('stage',choices=['gradient','fit','edge']);parser.add_argument('--workers',type=int,default=3)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    if args.stage=='gradient':check_gradient()
    elif args.stage=='fit':study(args.workers)
    else:edge_study(args.workers)

"""Plots and simple measurements for conditional_gaussian_gates.ipynb.

    branch_states   apply a gate to (|g> + |e>)/sqrt2 x (cavity state) and return the cavity state of each qubit branch
    squeezing_db    squeezing of a cavity state in dB and the angle of its squeezed quadrature
    wigner_panels   Wigner functions of the g and e branches: simulated gate vs ideal target
    sequence_plot   qubit and pump phase of every pi pulse, and the envelope of the whole gate
    iq_plot         programmed DAC I/Q (steps, 800 MS/s) and what the board outputs (after the converter's 8x filter)
"""
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import qutip as qt
from scipy.linalg import expm

import cd_trains as cd
import hardware_check as hw

GROUP_DELAY_NS = 22.65625            # delay of the RFDC interpolation filters (29, 11 and 7 taps at 1.6, 3.2, 6.4 GS/s)


def cavity_ops(levels):
    a = np.diag(np.sqrt(np.arange(1, levels)), 1)
    return a


def branch_states(train, x, cavity_state):
    """Gate applied to (|g> + |e>)/sqrt2 x cavity_state; returns (g-branch, e-branch) normalised cavity kets."""
    levels = train.space.levels
    psi = np.zeros(2 * levels, complex)
    psi[0::2] = cavity_state / np.sqrt(2)
    psi[1::2] = cavity_state / np.sqrt(2)
    out = played_state(train,x,psi)
    g, e = out[0::2], out[1::2]
    return g / np.linalg.norm(g), e / np.linalg.norm(e)


def played_state(train,x,initial,frame_angle=None):
    """Actual SDK+RFDC waveform on any input, with one fixed common Z frame."""
    q,s,_=hw.played_arrays(train,x)
    if frame_angle is None:frame_angle=train.report(x)['qubit_frame_Rz']
    state=np.asarray(initial,complex)
    vector=state.ndim==1
    if vector:state=state[:,None]
    out=hw.propagate(q,s,state,cd.DT/8,order=8,fast=True)
    out*=np.exp(-1j*frame_angle*train.space.z/2)[:,None]
    return out[:,0] if vector else out


def toggling_magnus(train,x):
    """Finite-drive toggling-frame first/second Magnus terms, a diagnostic.

    In H_I=sum_mu sigma_mu(c_mu a+c_mu* a†), integrate the actual q waveform
    exactly per fine sample. Use the midpoint qubit frame for that sample's
    sideband coefficient. No equality of a truncated Magnus series with the
    full gate is assumed. Output G2 satisfies U_I=exp[-i(G1+G2+...)].
    """
    q,s,_=hw.played_arrays(train,x);dt=cd.DT/8
    paulis=np.array([[[0,1],[1,0]],[[0,-1j],[1j,0]],[[1,0],[0,-1]]],complex)
    sp=np.array([[0,0],[1,0]],complex);Q=np.eye(2,dtype=complex)
    increments=np.empty((len(q),3),complex)
    for j,(drive,pump) in enumerate(zip(q,s)):
        magnitude=abs(drive)
        H=np.array([[0,drive.conjugate()],[drive,0]],complex)
        half=np.cos(magnitude*dt/2)*np.eye(2)-1j*(np.sin(magnitude*dt/2)/magnitude if magnitude else dt/2)*H
        mid=half@Q;B=mid.conj().T@sp@mid
        increments[j]=pump*dt*np.einsum('aij,ji->a',paulis,B)/2
        Q=half@mid
    first=np.cumsum(increments,axis=0)
    previous=first-increments
    aa=np.cumsum(np.cross(increments,previous),axis=0)
    nn=np.cumsum(np.cross(increments,previous.conj()).real,axis=0)
    return dict(time_us=np.arange(1,len(q)+1)*dt,first=first,aa=aa,nn=nn,
                final_qubit_unitary=Q)


def ideal_branches(train, cavity_state):
    """The target gate applied to the same input: (g-branch, e-branch)."""
    a = cavity_ops(train.space.levels)
    n = np.arange(train.space.levels)
    if train.gate == "squeeze":
        S = expm(train.strength / 2 * (a @ a - a.T @ a.T))
        return S @ cavity_state, S.T @ cavity_state
    return np.exp(-1j * train.strength * n) * cavity_state, np.exp(1j * train.strength * n) * cavity_state


def squeezing_db(ket):
    """Smallest quadrature variance relative to vacuum (in dB, positive = squeezed) and its angle (deg).
    Quadrature x_theta = (a e^{-i theta} + a^dag e^{i theta}) / sqrt2; vacuum variance 1/2."""
    a = cavity_ops(len(ket))
    mean_a = np.vdot(ket, a @ ket)
    mean_aa = np.vdot(ket, a @ a @ ket)
    mean_n = np.vdot(ket, a.T @ a @ ket).real
    thetas = np.linspace(0, np.pi, 3601)
    var = [0.5 + mean_n + np.real(mean_aa * np.exp(-2j * t)) - 2 * np.real(mean_a * np.exp(-1j * t)) ** 2 for t in thetas]
    i = int(np.argmin(var))
    return float(-10 * np.log10(var[i] / 0.5)), float(np.degrees(thetas[i]))


def coherent(levels, alpha):
    n = np.arange(levels)
    from scipy.special import gammaln
    return np.exp(-abs(alpha) ** 2 / 2 + n * np.log(abs(alpha) + 1e-300) - 0.5 * gammaln(n + 1)) * np.exp(1j * np.angle(alpha) * n)


def wigner_panels(train, x, cavity_state, title, extent=4.0):
    """2 x 2 Wigner functions: rows = qubit branch g / e, columns = simulated gate / ideal target."""
    sim = branch_states(train, x, cavity_state)
    ideal = ideal_branches(train, cavity_state)
    grid = np.linspace(-extent, extent, 161)
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(8, 7.6), constrained_layout=True)
    for row, branch in enumerate(("g", "e")):
        for col, (label, ket) in enumerate((("simulated gate", sim[row]), ("ideal target", ideal[row]))):
            W = qt.wigner(qt.Qobj(ket[:, None]), grid, grid)
            ax = axes[row, col]
            ax.contourf(grid, grid, W, 60, cmap="RdBu_r", vmin=-1 / np.pi, vmax=1 / np.pi)
            ax.set_aspect("equal")
            ax.set_title(f"qubit {branch}: {label}", fontsize=10)
            ax.set_xlabel("x = (a + a$^\\dagger$)/$\\sqrt{2}$")
            ax.set_ylabel("p = (a - a$^\\dagger$)/($i\\sqrt{2}$)")
    fig.suptitle(title)
    plt.show()
    return sim, ideal


def sequence_plot(train, x, title):
    """Top: qubit and pump phase of every pi pulse. Bottom: the drive envelopes of the whole gate."""
    t, q, s = cd.waveform(train, x)
    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(13, 5.5), constrained_layout=True)
    pulses = np.arange(1, train.cells + 1)
    ax1.plot(pulses, np.degrees(-x[:train.cells]) % 360, "o", ms=3, label="physical qubit DAC phase $-\\phi_j$")
    ax1.plot(pulses, np.degrees(x[train.cells:]) % 360, "s", ms=3, label="sideband (pump) phase $\\psi_j$ during cell j")
    ax1.set_xlabel("pi pulse number j"); ax1.set_ylabel("phase (deg)"); ax1.set_ylim(-5, 365); ax1.set_yticks(range(0, 361, 90))
    ax1.legend(fontsize=8, loc="upper right"); ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)
    ax2.plot(1e3 * t, abs(q) / (np.pi / cd.PI_TIME), lw=0.6, label="qubit drive |amplitude| / pi-pulse peak")
    ax2.plot(1e3 * t, abs(s) / train.g, lw=1.2, label="sideband |coupling| / g")
    ax2.set_xlabel("time (ns)"); ax2.set_ylabel("envelope"); ax2.legend(fontsize=8, loc="lower right"); ax2.grid(alpha=0.3)
    fig.suptitle(title)
    plt.show()


def iq_plot(train, x, start_pulse=10, n_pulses=4, title=""):
    """Programmed DAC I/Q (what is written to the board, 800 MS/s, held for 1.25 ns) and the closest thing to what the
    board outputs: the same words after the converter's 8x interpolation filter (6.4 GS/s), shifted back by its fixed
    22.66 ns delay so the two line up. Units: fraction of DAC full scale."""
    t, q, s = cd.waveform(train, x)
    q_scale, s_scale = hw.dac_scales(train.swap)
    _, q_prog = hw.to_words_and_back(q, np.pi / cd.PI_TIME, q_scale,qubit=True)
    _, s_prog = hw.to_words_and_back(s, train.g, s_scale)
    q_dac, s_dac = q_prog.conj() / (np.pi / cd.PI_TIME) * q_scale, s_prog / train.g * s_scale
    q_out, s_out = hw.rfdc_interpolate(q_dac), hw.rfdc_interpolate(s_dac)   # same units (each stage: x2 zeros, gain 2)
    t_out = cd.DT / 8 * np.arange(len(q_out)) - GROUP_DELAY_NS * 1e-3
    cell = cd.PI_TIME + train.gap
    t0 = cd.RAMP_SAMPLES * cd.DT + start_pulse * cell
    t1 = t0 + n_pulses * cell
    keep, keep_out = (t >= t0) & (t <= t1), (t_out >= t0) & (t_out <= t1)
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(13, 5.5), sharex=True, constrained_layout=True)
    for ax, prog, out, name in ((axes[0], q_dac, q_out, "qubit drive"), (axes[1], s_dac, s_out, "sideband (pump)")):
        for part, colour in (("I", "C0"), ("Q", "C3")):
            p = prog.real if part == "I" else prog.imag
            o = out.real if part == "I" else out.imag
            ax.step(1e3 * t[keep], p[keep], where="post", color=colour, lw=1, alpha=0.6, label=f"{part} programmed (800 MS/s)")
            ax.plot(1e3 * t_out[keep_out], o[keep_out], color=colour, lw=1.8, label=f"{part} out of the board (filtered)")
        ax.set_ylabel(f"{name}\n(fraction of full scale)"); ax.grid(alpha=0.3); ax.legend(fontsize=7, ncol=4, loc="upper right")
    axes[1].set_xlabel("time (ns)")
    fig.suptitle(title or f"pi pulses {start_pulse + 1}-{start_pulse + n_pulses}: programmed vs board output")
    plt.show()


def pulse_diagram(train, x, title, per_row=40):
    """The whole gate as a pulse diagram, wrapped into rows of `per_row` pi pulses. In each row the upper line is the
    qubit drive (one bar per 30 ns pi pulse), the lower line the sideband (one bar per cell, constant amplitude);
    colour = phase. White space on the qubit line = gaps (sideband only)."""
    cmap = plt.get_cmap("twilight")
    colour = lambda phase: cmap((phase % (2 * np.pi)) / (2 * np.pi))
    cell = cd.PI_TIME + train.gap
    ramp = cd.RAMP_SAMPLES * cd.DT
    rows = int(np.ceil(train.cells / per_row))
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(rows, 1, figsize=(14, 1.15 * rows + 0.9), squeeze=False, constrained_layout=True)
    for r, ax in enumerate(axes[:, 0]):
        for j in range(r * per_row, min((r + 1) * per_row, train.cells)):
            start = ramp + j * cell
            ax.barh(1, 1e3 * cell, left=1e3 * start, height=0.7, color=colour(x[train.cells + j]), edgecolor="none")
            ax.barh(2, 1e3 * cd.PI_TIME, left=1e3 * (start + train.gap / 2), height=0.7, color=colour(-x[j]),
                    edgecolor="k", lw=0.3)
        if r == 0:
            ax.barh(1, 1e3 * ramp, left=0, height=0.7, color="0.7")
        if r == rows - 1:
            ax.barh(1, 1e3 * ramp, left=1e3 * (ramp + train.cells * cell), height=0.7, color="0.7")
        ax.set_yticks([1, 2], ["sideband", "qubit pi"])
        ax.set_ylim(0.4, 2.6)
        ax.set_xlim(1e3 * (r * per_row * cell), 1e3 * ((r + 1) * per_row * cell + 2 * ramp))
        ax.text(1.003, 0.5, f"pulses {r * per_row + 1}-{min((r + 1) * per_row, train.cells)}", transform=ax.transAxes,
                fontsize=8, va="center")
    axes[-1, 0].set_xlabel("time (ns)")
    fig.colorbar(plt.cm.ScalarMappable(cmap=cmap, norm=plt.Normalize(0, 360)), ax=axes[:, 0], label="phase (deg)",
                 pad=0.06, fraction=0.02)
    fig.suptitle(title)
    plt.show()

cd_trains.py.source:
"""Conditional squeezing and conditional rotation from a train of 30 ns qubit pi pulses under a continuous sideband.

Used by conditional_gaussian_gates.ipynb and optimise_trains.py. Units: microseconds and radians.

PHYSICAL MODEL (coherent, two-level qubit, no loss, no static dispersive shift)
    H(t) = g_pump(t) (e^{i psi} sigma+ a + h.c.)                 resonant sideband ("pump"), on during the whole train
         + Omega(t) (e^{i phi} sigma+ + h.c.)                    qubit drive: 30 ns Hann pi pulses
Both drives are played as DAC samples, 1.25 ns each (800 MS/s), and held constant within a sample, so each sample's
propagator is an exact matrix exponential. A pi pulse is 24 samples, Omega_j = (pi/30 ns) sin^2(pi j / 24),
whose area makes exactly exp(-i (pi/2) sigma_x). The sideband coupling g = pi / (2 t_swap) (full swap time t_swap)
ramps up over 4 samples at the start and down over 4 samples at the end (phase 0).

A TRAIN is N cells. Cell j = [gap/2 of sideband only] [pi pulse at qubit phase phi_j] [gap/2], with the sideband at
phase psi_j throughout the cell. Gate time = N (30 ns + gap) + 10 ns (ramps).

WHY ONE MATRIX IS ENOUGH: changing the phases of a cell is a conjugation by the diagonal D = exp(i (phi k - psi n)),
with n = photon number and k = n + |e><e| - 1/2. (The sideband conserves k, so phi only moves the qubit-drive phase;
psi only moves the sideband phase.) So every cell is D_j U0 D_j^dag with ONE precomputed matrix U0, and the gradient
of the gate with respect to every phase is exact and cheap.

TARGETS on the inputs (qubit g or e) x (Fock n = 0..n_max), n_max = 8 by default; sigma_z |g> = +|g>:
    squeeze   S_z(r) = |g><g| S(r) + |e><e| S(-r),   S(r) = exp[r/2 (a^2 - a^dag^2)],  8 dB: r = 8 ln(10) / 20
    rotation  exp(-i theta sigma_z n): the g and e branches rotate by -theta and +theta (relative 2 theta)
    cd        conditional displacement exp[beta sigma_x (a^dag - a)]: displaced by +beta / -beta for sigma_x = +1 / -1
Allowed free correction after the train (a frame update, no time): a qubit Rz, chosen optimally.

FIDELITY: F = |Tr(T^dag W)|^2 / d^2, T and W the target and simulated output columns of the d = 2 (n_max + 1) inputs
(all photon numbers of the output kept up to the cutoff). Phases between all inputs count.
"""
import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import expm

DT = 0.00125                         # us, one DAC sample (800 MS/s)
PI_SAMPLES = 24                      # 30 ns pi pulse
PI_TIME = PI_SAMPLES * DT
RAMP_SAMPLES = 4                     # sideband ramp up / down, 5 ns each
R_8DB = 8 * np.log(10) / 20          # 0.92103: 8 dB squeezing


def pi_samples():
    """Qubit drive amplitude of the 24 samples of one pi pulse (start-of-sample values of a Hann)."""
    return np.pi / PI_TIME * np.sin(np.pi * np.arange(PI_SAMPLES) / PI_SAMPLES) ** 2


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# basis: (g0, e0, g1, e1, ...), index 2 n + (0 for g, 1 for e)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Space:
    def __init__(self, levels, n_input=9):
        if not (isinstance(levels,(int,np.integer)) and 1 <= n_input <= levels):
            raise ValueError('Require 1 <= number of input Fock states <= output levels.')
        self.levels, self.n_input = levels, n_input
        self.n = np.repeat(np.arange(levels), 2).astype(float)          # photon number of each basis state
        self.e = np.tile([0.0, 1.0], levels)                             # 1 for the excited qubit
        self.z = 1 - 2 * self.e                                          # sigma_z: +1 for g
        self.k = self.n + self.e - 0.5                                   # conserved by the sideband
        self.inputs = [2 * m for m in range(n_input)] + [2 * m + 1 for m in range(n_input)]   # g0.., e0..

    def hamiltonian(self, pump, drive):
        """H at phase 0: pump * (sigma+ a + h.c.) + drive * sigma_x (real symmetric)."""
        size = 2 * self.levels
        H = np.zeros((size, size))
        for m in range(self.levels):
            H[2 * m, 2 * m + 1] = H[2 * m + 1, 2 * m] = drive                       # g_m <-> e_m
            if m + 1 < self.levels:
                H[2 * m + 1, 2 * m + 2] = H[2 * m + 2, 2 * m + 1] = pump * np.sqrt(m + 1)   # e_m <-> g_{m+1}
        return H


def cell_matrix(space, g, gap):
    """U0: one cell at phases 0 = half gap, the 24 pi samples (sideband on), half gap."""
    half = expm(-1j * DT * space.hamiltonian(g, 0.0)) if gap > 0 else None
    U = np.eye(2 * space.levels, dtype=complex)
    if gap > 0:
        U = np.linalg.matrix_power(half, int(round(gap / 2 / DT))) @ U
    for omega in pi_samples():
        U = expm(-1j * DT * space.hamiltonian(g, omega)) @ U
    if gap > 0:
        U = np.linalg.matrix_power(half, int(round(gap / 2 / DT))) @ U
    return U


def ramp_matrices(space, g):
    """Sideband ramp up (sin^2) and down (cos^2), 4 samples each, phase 0, no qubit drive."""
    up = np.eye(2 * space.levels, dtype=complex)
    down = np.eye(2 * space.levels, dtype=complex)
    for j in range(RAMP_SAMPLES):
        up = expm(-1j * DT * space.hamiltonian(g * np.sin(np.pi * j / 8) ** 2, 0.0)) @ up
        down = expm(-1j * DT * space.hamiltonian(g * np.cos(np.pi * j / 8) ** 2, 0.0)) @ down
    return up, down


def target_columns(space, gate, strength):
    """Target output columns (2 levels x 2 n_input) for the inputs g0.., e0.."""
    size, N_INPUT = 2 * space.levels, space.n_input
    T = np.zeros((size, 2 * N_INPUT), complex)
    if gate == "cd":
        a = np.diag(np.sqrt(np.arange(1, space.levels)), 1)
        D = expm(strength * (a.T - a))                                   # D(beta); sigma_x = +-1 eigenstates (g +- e)/sqrt2
        plus, minus = (D + D.T) / 2, (D - D.T) / 2                       # D(-beta) = D(beta)^T for real beta
        for m in range(N_INPUT):
            T[0::2, m], T[1::2, m] = plus[:, m], minus[:, m]             # input g_m
            T[0::2, N_INPUT + m], T[1::2, N_INPUT + m] = minus[:, m], plus[:, m]   # input e_m
        return T
    if gate == "squeeze":
        a = np.diag(np.sqrt(np.arange(1, space.levels)), 1)
        S = expm(strength / 2 * (a @ a - a.T @ a.T))                    # S(r); S(-r) = S(r)^T
        for m in range(N_INPUT):
            T[0::2, m] = S[:, m]                                         # g input -> g branch squeezed by S(r)
            T[1::2, N_INPUT + m] = S.T[:, m]                             # e input -> e branch squeezed by S(-r)
    elif gate == "rotation":
        for col, idx in enumerate(space.inputs):
            T[idx, col] = np.exp(-1j * strength * space.n[idx] * space.z[idx])
    else:
        raise ValueError(gate)
    return T


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# the train
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class Train:
    """A train of N cells with a given sideband swap time and gap; evaluates gate fidelity and its exact gradient.

    Controls x = (phi_1..phi_N, psi_1..psi_N), all in radians. A structured train uses x = A @ p (see structure())."""

    def __init__(self, gate, strength, swap, cells, gap=0.0, levels=128, n_input=9):
        if swap <= 0 or cells < 1 or int(cells) != cells or gap < 0:
            raise ValueError('Require positive swap/cell count and a nonnegative gap.')
        if abs(gap/(2*DT)-round(gap/(2*DT))) > 1e-9:
            raise ValueError('Each half gap must contain a whole number of DAC samples.')
        self.gate, self.strength, self.swap, self.cells, self.gap = gate, strength, swap, cells, gap
        self.g = np.pi / (2 * swap)
        self.space = Space(levels, n_input)
        self.d = 2 * n_input                                             # number of inputs
        self.U0 = cell_matrix(self.space, self.g, gap)
        self.up, self.down = ramp_matrices(self.space, self.g)
        self.target = target_columns(self.space, gate, strength)
        self.time = cells * (PI_TIME + gap) + 2 * RAMP_SAMPLES * DT
        self.inputs = np.eye(2 * levels, dtype=complex)[:, self.space.inputs]

    def run(self, x, keep_states=False):
        """Output columns before the qubit frame correction (and the intermediate states, for the gradient)."""
        phi, psi = x[:self.cells], x[self.cells:]
        k, n = self.space.k[:, None], self.space.n[:, None]
        state = self.up @ self.inputs
        states = [state] if keep_states else None
        for j in range(self.cells):
            D = np.exp(1j * (phi[j] * k - psi[j] * n))                   # phases of cell j as a diagonal conjugation
            state = D * (self.U0 @ (D.conj() * state))
            if keep_states:
                states.append(state)
        out = self.down @ state
        return out, states

    def qubit_frame(self, out):
        """Best qubit Rz after the gate: makes the overlaps of the output's g rows and e rows with the target have the
        same phase."""
        zg = np.vdot(self.target[0::2], out[0::2])
        ze = np.vdot(self.target[1::2], out[1::2])
        angle = np.angle(ze) - np.angle(zg)                               # actual correction is Rz(-angle)
        return np.exp(1j * angle * self.space.z / 2)[:, None], angle

    def infidelity(self, x, gradient=True):
        """1 - F and its gradient with respect to x (exact, by back-propagation through the cells)."""
        out, states = self.run(x, keep_states=gradient)
        frame, _ = self.qubit_frame(out)
        trace = np.vdot(self.target, frame * out)
        cost = 1 - abs(trace / self.d) ** 2
        if not gradient:
            return cost
        # back-propagated target: B_j = (frame * down * C_N ... C_{j+1})^dag T
        k, n = self.space.k[:, None], self.space.n[:, None]
        back = self.down.conj().T @ (np.conj(frame) * self.target)
        phi, psi = x[:self.cells], x[self.cells:]
        grad = np.zeros(2 * self.cells)
        for j in range(self.cells - 1, -1, -1):
            after = states[j + 1]                                         # C_j S_{j-1}
            before = states[j]                                            # S_{j-1}
            D = np.exp(1j * (phi[j] * k - psi[j] * n))
            # dC/dphi S = i (k C S - C k S),  dC/dpsi S = -i (n C S - C n S)
            Ck = D * (self.U0 @ (D.conj() * (k * before)))
            Cn = D * (self.U0 @ (D.conj() * (n * before)))
            d_phi = 1j * (k * after - Ck)
            d_psi = -1j * (n * after - Cn)
            grad[j] = -2 * np.real(np.conj(trace) * np.vdot(back, d_phi)) / self.d ** 2
            grad[self.cells + j] = -2 * np.real(np.conj(trace) * np.vdot(back, d_psi)) / self.d ** 2
            back = D * (self.U0.conj().T @ (D.conj() * back))                 # back through C_j
        return cost, grad

    def report(self, x):
        """Gate fidelity, worst single-input fidelity, qubit frame angle, time."""
        out, _ = self.run(x)
        frame, angle = self.qubit_frame(out)
        overlaps = np.sum(np.conj(self.target) * (frame * out), axis=0)
        return dict(fidelity=float(abs(overlaps.sum() / self.d) ** 2),
                    worst_input_fidelity=float(np.min(abs(overlaps) ** 2)),
                    qubit_frame_Rz=float(-angle),
                    time_us=float(self.time), cells=self.cells, swap_ns=1e3 * self.swap, gap_ns=1e3 * self.gap,
                    top_level_population=float(np.max(np.sum(abs(out[-8:]) ** 2, axis=0))))

    def unitary_on(self, psi, x):
        """Apply the whole gate (with its frame corrections) to any state psi (length 2 levels)."""
        out, _ = self.run(x)
        frame, _ = self.qubit_frame(out)
        phi, ph = x[:self.cells], x[self.cells:]
        k, n = self.space.k, self.space.n
        state = self.up @ psi
        for j in range(self.cells):
            D = np.exp(1j * (phi[j] * k - ph[j] * n))
            state = D * (self.U0 @ (np.conj(D) * state))
        return frame[:, 0] * (self.down @ state)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# structured trains: x = A p, with fewer parameters p
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def structure(cells, kind, motif=None):
    """Matrix A (2N x P) mapping the free parameters p to the controls x = (phi, psi).
        "free"        every cell's qubit and pump phase free (P = 2N)
        "palindrome"  cell j and cell N+1-j have equal phase labels (P = N, N even);
                      exact sampled-Hamiltonian time symmetry is not assumed
        "motif"       a block of `motif` cells repeated N / motif times (P = 2 motif)
        "qubit only"  pump phase fixed at 0, qubit phases free (P = N)"""
    if kind == "free":
        return np.eye(2 * cells)
    rows = []
    if kind == "palindrome":
        assert cells % 2 == 0
        half = cells // 2
        A = np.zeros((2 * cells, 2 * half))
        for j in range(cells):
            src = j if j < half else cells - 1 - j
            A[j, src] = 1                                                # phi_j
            A[cells + j, half + src] = 1                                 # psi_j
        return A
    if kind == "motif":
        assert cells % motif == 0
        A = np.zeros((2 * cells, 2 * motif))
        for j in range(cells):
            A[j, j % motif] = 1
            A[cells + j, motif + j % motif] = 1
        return A
    if kind == "qubit only":
        A = np.zeros((2 * cells, cells))
        A[:cells, :cells] = np.eye(cells)
        return A
    raise ValueError(kind)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# the played waveform (for plotting): complex qubit and sideband samples vs time
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def waveform(train, x):
    """Legacy cell waveform: time (us), qubit drive and sideband (rad/us).

    This design surrogate keeps the original phase-zero outer pump ramps.
    New constant-phase/10ns-shaped protocols explicitly construct their own
    outer ramps and transitions before SDK packing; see verify_short_gates.
    """
    phi, psi = x[:train.cells], x[train.cells:]
    half_gap = int(round(train.gap / 2 / DT))
    q, s = [], []
    for j in range(RAMP_SAMPLES):
        q.append(0j); s.append(train.g * np.sin(np.pi * j / 8) ** 2)
    for p1, p2 in zip(phi, psi):
        pump = train.g * np.exp(1j * p2)
        q += [0j] * half_gap; s += [pump] * half_gap
        q += list(pi_samples() * np.exp(1j * p1)); s += [pump] * PI_SAMPLES
        q += [0j] * half_gap; s += [pump] * half_gap
    for j in range(RAMP_SAMPLES):
        q.append(0j); s.append(train.g * np.cos(np.pi * j / 8) ** 2)
    t = DT * np.arange(len(q))
    return t, np.array(q), np.array(s)

"""Check Markdown/notebook math and local links, without creating HTML files."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit

import mistune
import nbformat


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def walk(tokens):
    for token in tokens:
        yield token
        yield from walk(token.get('children', []))


def check(path):
    if path.suffix == '.ipynb':
        notebook = nbformat.read(path, 4)
        nbformat.validate(notebook)
        sections = [c.source for c in notebook.cells if c.cell_type == 'markdown']
    else:
        sections = [path.read_text()]
    equations = []
    links = 0
    for source in sections:
        assert source.count('$$') % 2 == 0
        assert '\\[' not in source and '\\]' not in source
        tokens = walk(mistune.create_markdown(renderer='ast', plugins=['math', 'table'])(source))
        for token in tokens:
            if token['type'] in ('inline_math', 'block_math'):
                equations.append(dict(text=token['raw'], display=token['type'] == 'block_math'))
            if token['type'] in ('link', 'image'):
                url = urlsplit(token['attrs']['url'])
                if not url.scheme and not url.netloc and url.path:
                    assert (path.parent/unquote(url.path)).exists(), url.path
                    links += 1
    assert len(equations) > 0
    bundles = sorted((Path.home()/'.vscode-server/bin').glob('*/node'))
    node = next(n for n in bundles if (n.parent/'node_modules/katex/dist/katex.js').exists())
    javascript = """
const fs = require('fs'); const katex = require(process.argv[1]);
const equations = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(0,'utf8'));
for (const e of equations) katex.renderToString(e.text,
 {displayMode:e.display,throwOnError:true,strict:'error'});
process.stdout.write(String(equations.length));
"""
    output = subprocess.run([str(node), '-e', javascript,
                             str(node.parent/'node_modules/katex/dist/katex.js')],
                            input=json.dumps(equations), text=True,
                            capture_output=True, check=True)
    assert int(output.stdout) == len(equations)
    result = dict(file=path.name, equations=len(equations),
                  display_equations=sum(e['display'] for e in equations),
                  local_links_checked=links, html_files_written=0)
    print('MARKDOWN CHECK', result)
    return result


if __name__ == '__main__':
    reports = [check(ROOT/name) for name in
               ['README.md', 'conditional_gaussian_gates.ipynb',
                'fast_conditional_displacement.ipynb', 'coupler_phase_transients.ipynb',
                'higher_order_cd_and_squeezing.ipynb']]
    assert len(reports) == 5
    (ROOT/'runs/audit/document_checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(reports, indent=2)+'\n')
    print('FINAL DOCUMENT COUNTS', len(reports), 'documents;',
          sum(r['equations'] for r in reports), 'equations;',
          sum(r['local_links_checked'] for r in reports), 'local links')

"""Larger-cutoff and half-step checks on the most strongly occupied inputs."""
import os
os.environ.setdefault('OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS','1')
os.environ.setdefault('OMP_NUM_THREADS','1')
import json
from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor,as_completed
import numpy as np
from coupler_phase_model import *
from calibrate_programmed_family import programmed_words,in_calibrated_frame

DATA=ROOT/'runs/coupler'


def check(job):
    kind,mode=job
    record=json.loads((DATA/f'vacuum_calibrated_{kind}.json').read_text())
    na,nc,dt=(24,10,.005) if mode=='cutoff' else (20,8,.0025)
    words=programmed_words(record)
    result,out=microscopic(words,Circuit(**record['reference_circuit']),na,nc,dt,inputs=[(0,8),(1,8)])
    out=in_calibrated_frame(out,record,na,nc,result['duration_ns'])
    prior=np.load(DATA/f'programmed_{kind}_a20_c8_dt0.005_columns.npz')['output'][:,[8,17]]
    embedded=np.zeros((na,nc,2,2),complex)
    embedded[:20,:8]=prior.reshape(20,8,2,2)
    embedded=embedded.reshape(out.shape)
    global_phase=np.angle(np.vdot(embedded,out))
    difference=float(max(np.linalg.norm(out*np.exp(-1j*global_phase)-embedded,axis=0)))
    assert difference<1e-5,(kind,mode,difference)
    result.update(kind=kind,check=mode,compared_input_columns=2,
                  compared_amplitudes=out.size,maximum_output_column_change=difference)
    print('MICROSCOPIC CONVERGENCE',kind,mode,'columns2;amplitudes',out.size,'change',difference,
          'seconds',result['elapsed_seconds'],flush=True)
    return result


if __name__=='__main__':
    jobs=[(kind,mode) for kind in ['constant','cartesian'] for mode in ['cutoff','timestep']]
    print('START4controlledconvergencecomparisons, g8/e8, larger24x10andhalfdt',flush=True)
    rows=[]
    with ProcessPoolExecutor(4) as pool:
        for result in pool.map(check,jobs):rows.append(result)
    assert len(rows)==4 and sum(r['compared_input_columns'] for r in rows)==8
